title: Momentum
desc: Momentum is a high-speed endless runner with three lanes, a doodle art style and a world that changes as your speed climbs. Play Momentum online for free and dash through the Animal Kingdom, the human world and futuristic alien realms in a single run. There is a global leaderboard too, so a clean run is worth more than a lucky one.
howto: Move between lanes with the left and right arrows or A and D.
Jump with the up arrow or space bar when an obstacle needs clearing.
Press the down arrow to slide under anything low.
On mobile, use the on-screen buttons or swipe to change lanes.
Keep surviving to unlock the next world and push your leaderboard rank.

controls.key: Left / Right Arrow or A / D

tips: Pick a lane early — drifting between two lanes costs you the run.
Jump late and small; early jumps leave you landing into the next obstacle.
Learn one world’s obstacle pattern before chasing distance.
Build a steady rhythm instead of sprinting through the easy sections.

faqs.question: What is Momentum?
faqs.answer: It is a high-speed endless runner where you switch lanes, jump and slide through worlds that change as your speed increases.

faqs.question: How do you control Momentum?
faqs.answer: Use the arrow keys or A and D on desktop, and the on-screen buttons or swipes on mobile. Space bar and the up arrow both jump.

faqs.question: Does Momentum have a leaderboard?
faqs.answer: Yes. It includes a global leaderboard with titles to unlock as your best runs improve.
